title.narrative: EU Support to legal migration, mobility and skills partnerships with North of African countries (THAMM +)

description.narrative: The proposed Action promotes a regional holistic approach to labour migration governance and labour mobility between North African countries and EU Member States (EU MS). It responds to one of the key priority areas of the New Pact on Migration and Asylum¿s external dimension on ¿developing legal pathways to Europe. The Action builds on and complements the existing regional action ¿Towards a Holistic Approach to Labour Migration Governance and Labour Mobility in North Africa¿(THAMM)¿ phase I and II.
